title: Mole's Burrow
text: “What!? Where in the world is there such writing?”
“Right here, I say.”

I had noticed a pattern that looked purely decorative but was actually carved into letters. That said, this script looked familiar, yet it wasn’t something I could just read off the top of my head. I gently applied a bit of fire magic to lightly scorch the area where the letters were, then showed it to Éclair.
“This is… it looks like Siltvelt script…”
“There was writing hidden here… I never knew.”
“Hmm… a secret hidden within this picture frame, meant for the people of the territory…”
“Is there a map of some kind?”
“It’s quite small, but if you look closely, this shape mimics the layout of Father’s territory. If we assume this hole here was made intentionally, then… here.”

Éclair carefully examined a section of the frame and seemed to have figured out the location. I had absolutely no idea about any of this. Now, hypothetically speaking—if this had been a loop where Father had purchased Crocodile Guy as a slave, then perhaps Éclair and Crocodile Guy would have stumbled upon this mystery together and ended up investigating it themselves.
“Let’s go confirm it.”
“Understood. First, let’s report this to Iwatani.”
“I’m right here, you know? Is this really a matter that requires relying on Father, I wonder?”
Was this really a problem worth bothering our busy Father over? Crocodile Guy and Éclair glanced at me briefly but quickly looked away again.

“Father wished for friendly relations with Siltvelt and was advancing a policy of reconciliation with the Demi-Humans. It would carry significant weight for Iwatani-dono, the Shield Hero, to be involved in this matter.”
“That’s the reasoning. First, we confirm.”
Hmm… well, it seemed necessary after all. And so Éclair went off to consult with Father.
“So apparently Eclair-san’s father left behind some kind of secret?”
“Yes, there was something he told me to do in case of emergency. It seems there was writing and a small map hidden within it…”
“Huh, so he was prepared for a rainy day.”
“I’d like to see it too, I say.”
Éclair and the others were examining the tiny map carved into the edge of the frame with a magnifying glass. So naturally, I wanted a look too.
“Here you go, Motoyasu-kun.”

After Éclair and Crocodile Guy finished looking at the map, I finally got my turn. Taking a look… yes, it certainly seemed to match the boundaries of Éclair’s territory. Of course, the borders would shift once Father received his own territory, but there was no mistake here. The map pointed to somewhere deep in the mountains east of Seaetto territory… which turned out to be Mole’s burrow. Right here.
“What’s here, then?”
“Mole’s burrow, I say.”
“Eh? Motoyasu-kun, do you know something?”
“I do indeed. This is Mole’s burrow.”
“Imiya-chan’s hometown?”
Exactly right. I nodded.

“Maybe we should ask Imiya-chan to check the map? No, wait, when I talked to her before, she said she didn’t really know where her home was within Melromarc… so that might be tricky. Come to think of it, it makes sense that Motoyasu-kun would know.”

Father seemed to accept this. Right, during the loop when we headed to Faubrey, there was a point where we returned to Melromarc and found Mole’s burrow under attack, and Father saved Mole then. So what could possibly be hidden in that same burrow?
“I wonder if Imiya-chan might know something… actually, no, she probably wouldn’t. Motoyasu-kun, do you know anything?”
“I don’t, I say. Is there something there?”
All I remembered was Mole’s burrow itself. And more importantly, none of the moles had ever said anything about it.
“Perhaps it’s something meant to stay hidden until it’s truly needed. In any case, going to investigate first seems wisest.”
“Right, confirming things first takes priority.”
“I suppose so… well, I’ll go ask Imiya-chan whether she wants to come along. It might be a painful place for her.”

With that, Father went off to speak with Mole. After a while, Mole came back together with him. It seemed she intended to come along. Keel and the others appeared to have caught wind of the conversation and were eavesdropping.
“So for this investigation, we’ll have Eclair-san, Shion, and Imiya-chan. Me and our guide Motoyasu-kun. Then Yuki-chan and—”
“Master, what about Filo?”
Oh! Filo-tan! This was shaping up to be the ultimate investigation!
“Filo-taaan!”

Just then, Rafumi appeared out of nowhere in a flash. Argh… now I couldn’t even tell if this was the real one. Rafumi was smirking, and I kept my mouth shut. Say something, I demanded of myself. Perhaps she thought it was finally her turn to shine after being absent for so long. Was she telling me not to lunge at her? This called for a loving embrace, I say. Gah…
“What about Kou?”
Here, Kou also threw his hat into the ring.

“All right, then Yuki-chan, Kou, and Filo-chan will carry us there. Yuki-chan, make sure you keep a firm grip on Motoyasu-kun’s arms and legs, okay? It’s fine if you squeeze tight enough that he can’t even get down.”
“Understood, I shall!”

What did you say!? Father, what kind of instructions are you giving Yuki-chan? Yuki-chan mounted me on her back and clamped my arms and legs tight with her feathers. Guh… here I was supposed to be going on an outing with Filo-tan, and instead Yuki-chan had me in a vice grip.
“Yay. Going out with Master.”
“Going out— Imiya, want to ride with Kou? Ahh, Elemlo, I wanted to go out with Raph and Rifana too.”
Oh, seeing Kou carry Mole on his back was a comforting sight indeed. No more worrying about Kou getting scolded by Father for wanting to eat Mole. I owed Elephant and Big Sister my thanks for that.
“Looks like Kou wants to carry Imiya-chan. So then I’ll—”
“Master—”
“Hmm. Seems like Filo-chan wants to carry me, so…”
“Then I shall ride with Kou alongside Imiya-dono. Shion, I leave Iwatani-dono in your care.”
“Understood.”
“Ren, you and Wolf stay on standby here. I’ll call if anything comes up.”
“I don’t know why you’re addressing me on this, but… fine, understood. Besides, if we’re going somewhere, I’m riding with Wyndia on Gaelion!”

It was starting to look like some strange factions were forming. To think Ren would cooperate with Assistant and the dragon. Luna-chan was glaring resentfully at the parent controlling Rival’s body. If I wasn’t careful, something terrifying might start radiating off Luna-chan. Depending on how things went, it might come to snatching sleeping Ren away from Rival’s parent and handing him over to her instead. And so, in this manner, we all set off to investigate Mole’s burrow.
“So somewhere in this mountain is where Imiya-chan and the others used to live…”

We had arrived near Mole’s burrow, deep in the mountains. Filo-tan, carrying Father, had come along too. Rafumi hadn’t followed—though if I lunged at her now, would that prove she was the fake one after all? Thanks to Rafumi’s habit of appearing and vanishing without warning, I couldn’t easily leap at just anyone, and it was maddening.
“Ah, this place looks familiar…”
Mole murmured, riding on Kou’s back while scanning the surroundings.
“It seems there’s no mistake. Kitamura-dono.”
“That’s exactly what I’ve been saying, isn’t it? This way, I say.”
Personally, I was far more interested in Filo-tan and Father than in Mole’s burrow, but there was nothing to be done about it, so I headed onward.
“Waaah—!”
Just then, Yuki-chan lurched forward and tumbled headlong! Dragged along with her, I went rolling down as well.
“Indeeed—!”

Round and round I tumbled! Right after, just as I felt something catch on me, a spiked ball woven from plants came slamming into me with tremendous force. A cloud of dust kicked up with a resounding thud.
“M-Motoyasu-samaaa!?”
I heard Yuki-chan’s startled voice.
“A trap!?”
“A trap, in a place like this!?”
Éclair and Crocodile Guy cried out in surprise, followed immediately by Father.
“Everyone, look at your feet! There are tons of things tied together with grass! And if you look closely, there are even thin cords laid out!”
